metadata.description: Trusted HTML→PDF→SharePoint publish under service identity. Triggered by POST /publish (Custom Connector) or status watch. Never accepts browser-uploaded PDF bytes.
metadata.trigger: When publish command is received OR optional watch on approved documents
metadata.idempotency: If publishedcontentrevision equals requested revision and publishedpdfurl is set, return existing artifact (no new file).

When_publish_command.description: Preferred: Custom Connector / unbound action from Code App Publish button with publishDestinationId

When_document_approved.description: Optional secondary trigger; still resolve destination from allowlist, never from free-form URL columns alone

Resolve_publish_destination.description: Load dr_publishdestination by id (or document type default). Reject inactive rows and folder overrides outside the allowlisted root.

Check_idempotency.description: If status=published AND publishedcontentrevision == submitted/content revision AND publishedpdfurl set → return existing URL/item id

Render_html_and_pdf.description: Render approved revision markdown/HTML to PDF under service identity (Playwright/Flows PDF, etc.). Do not accept client contentBase64.

Upload_to_SharePoint.description: Create/overwrite file named {slug}-{id8}-r{rev}.pdf in allowlisted library/folder. Same revision overwrites safely; new revision uses a new name.

Create_history_event.description: POST history action=published with actor = service principal (or initiating publisher)
